answer_1.quote: Task-oriented dialogue systems help users to achieve specific goals such as restaurant reservation or navigation inquiry. ... the end-to-end dialogue system directly generates system response given the query and a corresponding knowledge base (KB).

answer_2.quote: Follow the prior work , we adopt the BLEU and Micro Entity F1 metrics to evaluate model performance.

answer_4.quote: We provide human evaluation on our framework and other baseline models. ... We hired human experts and asked them to judge the quality of the responses according to correctness, fluency, and humanlikeness on a scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: judge the quality of responses on a scale from 1 to 5 based on correctness, fluency, and humanlikeness
